The Board welcomed the Economic Development Collaborative proposal without a vote; Member Alonzo asked for a written proposal when available.

budget_items.topic: ARPA funding request from the Economic Development Committee (Collaborative website)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The request was re-estimated from $2,500 to a $1,200 contribution toward a regional collaborative website; no vote was taken.
budget_items.quote: stated they are being asked to contribute $1,200 for development of the collaborative website.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chair Jeffreys gave the available ARPA balance as $58 K plus interest.
budget_items.quote: chair jeffreys replied that there is $58 k plus the $101k in interest.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Appraisal-based easement awards were stated for 890 and 914 Flat Hill Road, and the takings were awarded a total of $5,100.00.
budget_items.quote: noted the rates for compensation to property owners based on appraisals - 890 flat hill rd.- $3,000 and 914 flat hill rd- $2,100 for easement awards.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bill Bernard said Capital Plan requests were filed and the upgrades still need funding; a separate remark said $40K remains in the Capital Plan for the Flat Hill project.
budget_items.quote: he also confirmed there is still $40k in the capital plan for this project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The owner has not paid back taxes and had a payment agreement; no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: she added that the owner has not paid the back taxes and had a payment agreement.

budget_items.topic: Personal property maintenance and utility appraisal services RFQ
budget_items.what_was_recorded: One proposal was received from RFC and the Assistant Town Manager awarded the bid, at the three-year prices printed.
budget_items.quote: they received 1 proposal from rfc for $21,100 for fy25, $22,600 for fy26 and $23,200 for fy27.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The state appropriated $5 Million for the September Storm; the town requested $75,000 from FEMA, and FEMA denied the state's request, which the state will appeal.
budget_items.quote: the state did appropriate $5 million in the fall for the september storm

budget_items.topic: FEMA reimbursement for Covid-related services (Fire Department)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Fire Department submitted paperwork for a FEMA reimbursement that will become a local receipt when received.
budget_items.quote: the fire department submitted paperwork 3 years ago for $66,780.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The MIIA insurance increase for active town and school employees was finalized at 5.7%, down from an initial estimate of 10%, revised to 6.6%.
budget_items.quote: the insurance increase will be 5.7% for active town and school employees.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Monty Tech notified the town of a 3.75% increase; the School Committee votes on the budget 3/6.
budget_items.quote: monty tech - town manager was notified that there will be a 3.75% increase for $44,256.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A new contract with BP starting November 2024 was to be secured at a rate lower than the current 48-month rate.
budget_items.quote: they will be securing a new contract with bp for $.1177/kwh. the current rate is $.11868/kwh for 48 months.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $3,500 grant was received to replace cold water rescue suits and accessories for the inflatable sled.
budget_items.quote: the fire department received an emergency performance grant for $3,500 to replace 2 cold water rescue suits

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An $18,800 grant was awarded to update 3 power saws and 3 radios.
budget_items.quote: also $18,800 for the fire fighter safety grant to update 3 power saws and 3 radios.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The warrants were presented: an accounts payable warrant, a payroll adjustment and a payroll warrant; no vote is recorded on them.
budget_items.quote: accounts payable warrant in the amount of $ 668,531.70. payroll adjustment of $744.45.

budget_items.topic: FY24 budget and state aid (Chapter 70 foundation bump)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lunenburg received a $730,000 Chapter 70 bump in FY23 as a foundation community, which disqualified it from Chapter 70 aid for FY24.
budget_items.quote: when they received a large bump of $730,000 in chapter 70 money as a foundation community.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bill Bernard said the town needs to find money to do the stormwater upgrades; no figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: they just need to find money to do the upgrades.
